parameters.name: ContainerGroupIds
parameters.description: The IDs of the ECI instances. You can specify up to 20 IDs. The value must be a JSON-formatted string.

parameters.name: EventSource
parameters.description:
The event source. Valid values:

- EciService

- K8sAgent

If you leave this parameter empty, all events are queried.

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description:
The maximum number of ECI instances to return. Default value: 200.

> The response may contain fewer entries than the specified value.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The token that is used to start the next query. If this parameter is left empty, no more data is returned.

You do not need to set this parameter for the first query. Obtain the token for subsequent queries from the response.

parameters.name: SinceSecond
parameters.description: Returns only new events to enable incremental polling.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags that are attached to the ECI instances.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The tag key of the ECI instance.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value of the ECI instance.
